950 likes, 86 comments - financebyanmoll on September 23, 2026: "My personal view is simple: whatever the issue is, I hope it gets resolved through dialogue between bank employees and the concerned authorities.

Strikes ultimately affect common people the most, especially those who still depend heavily on physical banking services for important transactions.

Hopefully, both sides can find a solution and the strike can be avoided.".
